papers.title: The justice-held population, England and Wales
papers.standfirst: A quarterly composite series of the people whose liberty is conditioned by the criminal justice system: in prison, under supervision, or waiting for a courtroom. It has grown by a quarter since 2019, and almost all of the growth is in the queue.

papers.title: How good are the Ministry of Justice prison population projections?
papers.standfirst: Eighteen editions since 2008, every central projection scored against what happened at every horizon. The projections have been too high at every horizon, and a forecaster who assumed no change would have beaten them on identical targets.
